newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan research body seeks abolition of bond tax.
newsitem.headline: Japan research body seeks abolition of bond tax.

text.p: A Japanese research group is calling for the abolition of a law that imposes a tax on income gains from domestic bond investments, including Japanese government bonds, by foreign investors.
Fuji Research Institute Corp said the tax hurt the competitiveness of the bond market.
"It is essential to abolish the law, which imposes a withholding tax on income made by foreign investors from bond investments," it said in a report.
Fuji said the heavy taxes Japan imposes on foreigners were a major reason why the Tokyo market was losing its competitiveness compared with other major markets in Europe and the United States.
